## Description

Select or weight stocks with lower trailing volatility or beta to build a defensive equity portfolio.

## Where it may fit

Risk-controlled mandates, volatile markets or investor preferences for lower drawdowns—though not guaranteed.

## Vehicles

Low-volatility/minimum-volatility ETFs, defensive equity funds.

## Required data

Daily/monthly returns, covariance or beta estimates, market cap, sector exposures and liquidity.

## Caveats

Can be sector-concentrated and may lag sharply in speculative rallies.
